trades.audit:
GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: D
GRADE_noahsaint: B
WINNER: noahsaint
ANALYSIS:
Jonathon Brooks is a 27‑year‑old running back who has remained a depth piece with limited touches and no clear path to a starting role. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is a 26‑year‑old running back who has seen increased involvement in his team's backfield and retains upside as a potential starter. Consequently, noahsaint received the higher‑value asset.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B+
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: A
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup receives elite quarterback Patrick Mahomes, a low‑impact running back in Chuba Hubbard, and a 2028 first‑round pick. Worthy of my Chuba receives a high‑upside but unproven quarterback Anthony Richardson, two 2027 first‑round picks, and a 2028 third‑round pick, delivering substantially more future capital. The latter side therefore captures greater dynasty value.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: A-
GRADE_Chicken Soup: C+
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Joe Burrow is an established elite quarterback with multiple playoff runs, providing immediate high floor and ceiling. The two future third‑round picks add modest depth but retain value. Brock Bowers, while a top rookie tight end with upside, cannot match the proven production and positional premium of Burrow, making the trade heavily in Fire Haslam Into The Sun's favor.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: B
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Bryce Young is a young, high‑upside starting quarterback, providing immediate elite production, while the 2028 third‑round pick adds modest future depth. Sam Darnold offers limited upside as a backup, but the 2028 first‑round pick represents a premium asset, giving Syracuse a stronger overall return.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B
GRADE_spearson22: A
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup received a 2029 first‑round pick, which will be two drafts away and thus less valuable than an earlier pick. spearson22 obtained a 2028 first‑round pick, giving them access to top‑tier talent a year sooner. Consequently, spearson22 captured the superior asset in this trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Dayton acquired proven TE T.J. Hockenson, a top‑tier fantasy asset, plus depth TE AJ Barner and a 2029 fourth‑round pick. Justin received three future mid‑round picks (2027 3rd, 2028 4th, 2029 4th) which have potential but lack the immediate, high‑upside production of Hockenson. The proven elite TE outweighs the speculative value of the picks, giving Dayton the better side of the trade.

GRADE_T-Mac Attack: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Jordan Mason is a third‑year running back with limited upside and a 2027 fourth‑round pick is a modest future asset. Justin Jefferfather receives a 2027 third‑round and a fourth‑round pick, providing two draft assets and a higher‑value selection. The extra pick and higher round give Justin a clear dynasty advantage.

GRADE_noahsaint: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Josh Downs provides a proven but limited upside WR slot in 2026, likely a depth or low‑end WR2. A 2027 second‑round pick carries significant future value and can be used to draft a high‑upside rookie or packaged in trades. Therefore the pick side clearly outweighs the immediate player value.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C+
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B+
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
Dayton received two 2027 second‑round picks, which are future assets roughly one year away and lack immediate production. All Gas No Bench acquired D'Andre Swift, a proven NFL running back who can contribute immediately and has upside in a dynasty format. The immediate, proven value of Swift outweighs the speculative future picks, giving All Gas No Bench the better side.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: D
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B-
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Emanuel Wilson is a depth‑level running back with limited upside in the current dynasty landscape. A 2028 third‑round pick offers a future asset that could develop into a starter, giving Justin Jefferfather the superior return.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B-
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse receives veteran WR Amon‑Ra St. Brown, a reliable but aging asset, plus a 2027 third‑round and 2028 fourth‑round pick, which are modest future assets. Justin receives RB De'Von Achane, a young player with high upside, and two premium 2027 picks (first‑ and second‑round), providing significant upside and draft capital. The combination of higher‑value picks and a high‑upside back gives Justin a clear dynasty advantage.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: A-
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
Tre Tucker is a young, high‑upside wide receiver entering his third season with a clear role in a productive offense, offering immediate and future fantasy value. The 2028 third‑ and fourth‑round picks are two‑year‑away assets that are uncertain and typically yield lower‑impact players. Consequently, MaxWeese25 receives the superior dynasty return.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: D
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
De'Von Achane is a proven, high‑upside RB entering his fourth season, while Quinshon Judkins and Jadarian Price remain unproven depth pieces. Syracuse also receives a 2027 2nd‑round pick (one‑year‑out) and a 2029 3rd‑round pick, whereas Fire only gets a 2028 2nd‑rounder two years away. The combination of a starter RB and superior draft capital gives Syracuse a clear advantage.

GRADE_noahsaint: B-
GRADE_spearson22: B+
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Noahsaint only received a single 2026 third‑round pick, which provides limited future upside. Spearson22 obtained that same third‑rounder plus an additional 2026 fourth‑round pick, increasing their draft capital and flexibility. Consequently, spearson22 captured the superior dynasty value.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: F
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
All Gas No Bench received only one 2026 second‑round pick while giving up two identical picks. Syracuse Sandstorms retained both of their 2026 second‑round selections, gaining an extra draft asset. The additional second‑rounder provides Syracuse a clear dynasty advantage, making the trade heavily lopsided in their favor.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C+
GRADE_T-Mac Attack: B+
WINNER: T-Mac Attack
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam received two second‑round picks (2026, 2028), which add future depth but lack the immediate upside of a first‑rounder. T‑Mac Attack secured a 2026 first‑round pick, offering a higher chance at a top‑tier talent now. Consequently, T‑Mac Attack obtained superior dynasty value.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Deebo Samuel Sr. is an aging veteran wide receiver with limited upside in a dynasty context, offering immediate but short‑term production. A 2027 third‑round pick provides a future asset that can be used to draft a young talent or packaged for a higher return, giving Worthy of my Chuba more long‑term value. Consequently, Worthy of my Chuba received the better side of the trade.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: A-
GRADE_Mr texas: B+
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
MaxWeese25 receives a 2026 first‑round and a 2026 second‑round pick, both immediate high‑value assets that can be used to draft top‑tier talent. Mr texas gets three established veterans—Hunter Henry, David Montgomery, and Michael Pittman Jr.—plus a 2026 third‑rounder and a 2027 first‑rounder, but the players have limited upside and the picks are lower or delayed. The combination of two early 2026 picks outweighs the veteran package and later picks, giving MaxWeese25 the better side.

GRADE_Mr texas: C-
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Kenny Gainwell is a depth receiver with limited upside, while a 2026 first‑round pick offers immediate top‑tier value. Syracuse receives two first‑round picks (2026 and 2027), giving them two high‑value assets versus Mr texas’s single first‑rounder and a 2028 third‑rounder. Consequently, Syracuse captured the superior dynasty return.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A-
GRADE_spearson22: C+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse receives a 2026 first‑round pick and a 2028 second‑round pick, giving them high‑upside, controllable assets for the next two seasons. spearson22 gets veteran WR Courtland Sutton, depth RB Rico Dowdle, and a 2027 second‑round pick, which together provide immediate but limited upside. The first‑round pick outweighs the veteran pieces, making Syracuse the clear winner.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: B+
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: A-
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
De'Von Achane offers high upside at RB in a league where elite backs are scarce, but he is paired with a 2027 third‑round pick, which is modest. DeVonta Smith provides proven WR production and is coupled with a more valuable 2027 second‑round pick, giving All Gas a stronger immediate and future asset mix. Consequently, All Gas No Bench extracts greater overall dynasty value.
